G2: all 5328000 query-region-prefix bounds <= reaggregated original truth; C8>=C4, zero false topK pruning, metadata roundtrip

G4: 128 frozen pairs each for P1 and P2, seeds2026101201/2026101202, 43L3+43L4+42L5; all objects per pair independently reprojected and ordered original scores recomputed from original FP32 vectors; endpoint/truth bytes match
hard_query_selection: six greatest original G0 leaf visited-object counts; display in original frozen order, before P2 results
sensitivity: report exception individually and pooled leave-660835-out using7M denominator; primary8 unchanged

cost: build process CPU/resource elapsed/sort count/explicit scratch array proxy/process cumulative highwater; no query latency. P0 load/audit is not original GTS build cost.
